{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT – Create a premium static Vue website for a travel creator link-in-bio / portfolio page called “Mira Miles”. Build it as a fully responsive static front-end only site, no backend, no login, no database, no APIs, no booking engine. Use mock/static content and placeholder images/cards where needed.

GOAL
Design a beautiful scroll-driven travel link-in-bio portfolio that feels like a mix of Spotify Wrapped gradients + modern creator media kit + interactive travel journal. It should be a single-page website but with many sections, smooth anchor navigation, sticky mini-player style header, animated gradients, and scroll-based reveals. The visitor should quickly understand who Mira is, explore her trips, click social/link buttons, view portfolio highlights, brand collaboration info, and contact details. Everything must work as a static site.

TECH
- Use Vue
- Static website only
- Can use normal CSS / Tailwind-style utility classes if helpful
- No external live services required
- No real map APIs, no real embeds needed
- All data can be local arrays / static JSON inside the project
- Use placeholder images with nice travel gradients if images are not available

VISUAL STYLE
- Inspiration: Spotify app / Spotify Wrapped but for travel
- Gradient style is required: deep ocean blue, sunset orange, tropical pink, lime green accents, violet night sky
- Dark premium base with glowing cards
- Big rounded sections, glassmorphism panels, subtle grain texture, pill buttons
- Typography: bold editorial headlines + clean readable body text
- Mood: adventurous, music-like rhythm, curated playlist of places
- Use scroll-driven animations: cards fade up, timeline reveals, sticky sections, progress indicator, changing gradient backgrounds as user scrolls
- Mobile first, looks excellent on phone because it is a link-in-bio site

STRUCTURE

1. LOADING / INTRO FEEL
Not a real loading screen necessary, but make the hero feel like an intro card:
- Small label: “Travel creator • photo stories • slow escapes”
- Huge headline: “Mira Miles”
- Subtitle: “A visual passport through coastlines, train windows, markets, mountains, and tiny cafes.”
- CTA buttons:
  - “Explore links”
  - “View portfolio”
  - “Collab kit”
- Add a Spotify-like vertical soundwave decoration or equalizer bars, but purely CSS, no audio needed
- Add floating chips: “42 cities”, “18 countries”, “7 travel guides”, “2026 media kit”

2. STICKY TOP BAR
- Sticky or floating header that appears while scrolling
- Left: circular avatar / logo “MM”
- Center: mini navigation pills: Links, Trips, Guides, Collabs, Contact
- Right: small status pill “Currently in: Lisbon”
- On mobile make it compact / horizontal scroll if needed

3. LINK-IN-BIO HUB SECTION
Create a premium link card stack, not plain buttons. Each link should have icon style, title, short description, and CTA arrow.
Links:
- Latest Travel Reel
- Download Media Kit
- Destination Guides
- Photography Portfolio
- Newsletter Signup Mock Link
- Brand Collab Inquiry
- Packing List
- Favorite Cafes Map Mock Preview
IMPORTANT: These are static links/buttons only. They can point to # sections or placeholder href="#". No real forms required except visual static contact form.

4. “NOW PLAYING: DESTINATIONS” SECTION
Make this feel like a Spotify playlist but for travel places.
Title: “Now Playing: Destinations”
Cards should look like playlist/song rows:
- 01 Amalfi in Blue Hour — Italy — coastal story
- 02 Night Train to Kyoto — Japan — slow travel journal
- 03 Rooftop Rain in Bangkok — Thailand — city guide
- 04 Sahara Gold — Morocco — desert photo essay
- 05 Fog Over Madeira — Portugal — hiking diary
Each row: number, thumbnail gradient/image, destination, mood tag, fake duration like “4 min read”, animated equalizer on active row.
On scroll, highlight one row as “featured”. This can be CSS/JS scroll state or simple visual.

5. SCROLL STORY / TRAVEL TIMELINE
A long vertical timeline with sticky year labels:
- 2021 Started with weekend train trips
- 2022 First solo travel photo essay
- 2023 Partnered with boutique hotels and local guides
- 2024 Published city guide collection
- 2025 Built slow-travel community
- 2026 Open for destination campaigns
Each item should have a colorful gradient background, little stat chips, and image placeholder.
Use scroll reveal animation.

6. FEATURED PORTFOLIO GRID
Complex responsive grid / masonry feel, static cards:
Categories filter UI visual only or functional local filtering if easy:
- Coast
- Cities
- Mountains
- Food
- Stays
- Trains
Portfolio cards:
- “Pastel Streets of Porto”
- “How to Spend 48 Hours in Seoul”
- “A Quiet Hotel in the Dolomites”
- “Markets Before Sunrise”
- “Island Hopping Without a Rush”
- “The Train Window Series”
Each card includes: category, title, short description, location, mock image area, hover overlay.

7. DESTINATION GUIDE CAROUSEL / HORIZONTAL SCROLL
Make a scrollable horizontal strip like Spotify albums.
Guide cards:
- Lisbon Weekend Guide
- Tokyo Coffee Walks
- Bali Calm Beaches
- Paris Rainy Day List
- Mexico City Color Route
- Iceland Ring Road Notes
Each includes price label like “Free guide” or “PDF sample”, but no payment functionality.
Add progress dots or drag hint. Static is fine.

8. COLLAB / MEDIA KIT SECTION
This is portfolio-site important.
Show creator stats using static numbers:
- 128K monthly impressions
- 64K social community
- 8.7% average engagement
- 31 brand campaigns
- 72% audience: 22–34
Add note: “Sample metrics for static demo.”
Include collaboration formats:
- Destination storytelling
- Hotel photography
- Short-form travel videos
- Itinerary content
- Product-in-context shoots
- Newsletter feature mockup
Add testimonial cards with fake/sample testimonials:
- Boutique hotel owner
- Sustainable luggage brand
- Tourism board editor
No real names necessary, sample content is ok.

9. TRAVEL MOOD SELECTOR
Interactive front-end only component:
Prompt: “Pick your travel mood”
Buttons:
- Ocean
- City lights
- Mountain air
- Food crawl
- Slow train
When clicked, update a static recommendation card with matching gradient, title, destination, and playlist-like vibe. No API.
Example Ocean result: “Madeira cliffs + salt wind + golden hour hikes.”

10. JOURNAL / EDITORIAL PREVIEW
Create a blog preview section with 3 large editorial cards:
- “The Art of Doing Less While Traveling”
- “A Packing List for People Who Hate Packing”
- “Finding Cafes That Feel Like Movie Scenes”
Each has date, tag, read time, and excerpt. Static cards only.

11. CONTACT / COLLAB INQUIRY MOCK FORM
Visual-only static form section:
Fields:
- Name
- Email
- Brand / project
- Destination
- Campaign type dropdown
- Message
Button: “Send inquiry”
Since no backend: clicking can show a small front-end-only success toast like “Demo only — message not sent.” or prevent default.
Add direct static contact line: hello@miramiles.example

12. FOOTER
- Logo Mira Miles
- Social link buttons: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Newsletter
- Small text: “Static portfolio demo. All destinations, metrics, and links are sample content.”
- Back to top button

INTERACTIONS REQUIRED
- Smooth scrolling between anchor sections
- Scroll progress bar at top or side
- Scroll reveal animations for cards
- Gradient background changes or section-specific gradient blobs while scrolling
- Hover animations on link cards and portfolio cards
- Mobile hamburger or compact nav optional but site must be mobile friendly
- Front-end-only mood selector
- Mock form toast

CONTENT RULES
- Use polished copy, not lorem ipsum
- Everything is static / mock content
- No real API keys or embedded services
- No login/account/admin
- No server-side code
- No database
- No WebGL/3D/canvas game stuff

DELIVERABLE
A finished Vue static website that can be opened locally and looks like a real high-end travel creator link-in-bio portfolio. Prioritize visual polish, gradients, responsive layout, scroll-driven storytelling, and Spotify-inspired playlist/card language.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
